title: Difference between squared sum and sum of squares
summary: A math practice tool compares two totals for the first n positive integers: the square of their sum and the sum of their individual squares. Return the difference using the requested formula. Compute (1+...+n) squared minus (1²+...+n²).
hints: Use arithmetic-series formulas instead of nested loops.
Compute the square of the sum and subtract the sum of squares.
